sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
sources.authority_reason: Lewis等RAG方法原始論文，由原作者給出retriever/generator、外部記憶與索引替換實驗。
sources.inspection_note: 本人讀§2 p2–3: retrieve text documents as additional context；§2.3 p3 concatenate input x and retrieved z；§2.4實際原方法fine-tunes query encoder/BART；§4.5 pp7–8和§6 p9 index hot-swapping can update knowledge without retraining；Broader Impact p10來源可能不正確。只支持流程和成立可能性，不把本文ASCII lexical小模型說成DPR/BART latent-doc RAG的重現，也不保證引用或答案正確。

sources.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
sources.authority_reason: Brown等原始GPT-3研究，明確定義in-context few-shot與fine-tuning的參數更新區分。
sources.inspection_note: 本人實讀§2 Approach pp6–7與Figure2.1：few-shot examples serve as inference-time conditioning with no weight updates; only forward passes at test time。用于A.2對明示前置A.1的比較，不替小模型或人工公告範例宣稱廣泛能力。
